paite: Huan TOUPA'N Mosi ahoupih a,
heading: Tup Louh Khelhnate Thillat
english: Yahweh spoke to Moses, saying,

paite: "Israel suante houpih inla, akiang uah, 'TOUPA'N thilhih louh ding a thu apiakte, abangpeuh leng mi'n na hihkhial kha in, abangpeuh leng na hih taleh,
english: “Speak to the children of Israel, saying, ‘If anyone sins unintentionally, in any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and does any one of them:

paite: thaunilh siampu in thil ahihkhelh amipite tung a mohpaihna atunsakleh athilhihkhelhsa thoihna ding in TOUPA kiang ah ganhon lak a pan bawngtuai gensiatbei, khelh thoihna ding in lan hen,
english: if the anointed priest sins so as to bring guilt on the people, then let him offer for his sin, which he has sinned, a young bull without blemish to Yahweh for a sin offering.

paite: Bawng pen kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi bul ah TOUPA ma ah ahon kai dia, bawng lutung ah akhut akoih dia, TOUPA ma ah huai bawng agou ding ahi”.
english: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the bull, and kill the bull before Yahweh.

paite: Thaunilh siampu in bawng sisan bangzah hiam ala dia, kihoupihna biakbuk ah ahon tawi ding hi.
english: The anointed priest shall take some of the blood of the bull, and bring it to the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Siampu in sisan ah akhut adiah dia, akhenkhat TOUPA ma ah, mun siangthou puanzak bul ah sagihvei atheh ding ahi.
english: The priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle some of the blood seven times before Yahweh, before the veil of the sanctuary.

paite: Siampu in TOUPA ma ah kihoupihna biakbuk a gimlimtak maitam kiite ah huai sisan bangzah hiam atat ding ahi. Bawng sisan tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kiang a halmang thillat maitam bul ah asungkhe ding ahi.
english: The priest shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar of sweet incense before Yahweh, which is in the Tent of Meeting; and he shall pour out all of rest of the blood of the bull at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Khelh thoihna bawng thau tengteng, asungkua thau leh agilbom teng leng ala vek dia;
english: He shall take all the fat of the bull of the sin offering off of it; the fat that covers the innards, and all the fat that is on the innards,

paite: akal nihte leh aphuk chin a om, atuamthau leh asin tuam alam, akal nihte nangawn toh asuah ding ahi.
english: and the two kidneys, and the fat that is on them, which is by the loins, and the cover on the liver, with the kidneys, he shall take away,

paite: Lemna thillat kithoihna bawngtal a kipan alak bang in, siampu in halmang thillat maitam ah ahal ding ahi.
english: as it is taken off of the bull of the sacrifice of peace offerings. The priest shall burn them on the altar of burnt offering.

paite: Bawngvunte, asa tengtengte, alu toh, akhete toh, asungkuate, a-ekte,
english: The bull’s skin, all its flesh, with its head, and with its legs, its innards, and its dung,

paite: abawng pumpi toh giahphual polam mun siang ah, vut paihna ah apaipih dia, sing tung ah ahal ding, vut paihna ahal ding ahi,' achi hi.
english: even the whole bull shall he carry forth outside the camp to a clean place, where the ashes are poured out, and burn it on wood with fire. Where the ashes are poured out it shall be burned.

paite: "Israel omkhawm tengteng in ahihkhelh khak ua, mipi mitmuh a sel ahih a, TOUPA'N hih louh ding a thu apiakte, abang mahmah ahih ua,
english: “‘If the whole congregation of Israel sins, and the thing is hidden from the eyes of the assembly, and they have done any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and are guilty;

paite: siam louh atan ua, athil gilou hih uh theihkhiak ahihleh, mipi in khelh thoihna ding in bawngtuai alan ding ua, kihoupihna biakbuk kong ah ahon kai ding uhi.
english: when the sin in which they have sinned is known, then the assembly shall offer a young bull for a sin offering, and bring it before the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Upa omkhawmte'n TOUPA ma ah bawng lutung ah akhut uh akoih ding ua; TOUPA ma a huai bawng goh ding ahi.
english: The elders of the congregation shall lay their hands on the head of the bull before Yahweh; and the bull shall be killed before Yahweh.

paite: Thaunilh siampu in kihoupihna biakbuk ah bawng sisan bangzah hiam ahon tawi ding hi.
english: The anointed priest shall bring of the blood of the bull to the Tent of Meeting:

paite: Siampu in huai sisan ah akhutzung adiah dia, puanzak bul ah TOUPA ma ah sagihvei atheh ding hi.
english: and the priest shall dip his finger in the blood, and sprinkle it seven times before Yahweh, before the veil.

paite: Sisan pen kihoupihna biakbuk a TOUPA ma ah maitam kii ah tam lou atat dia, sisan tengteng kihoupihna biakbuk kongpi kiang a halmang thillat maitam bul ah asungkhe ding ahi.
english: He shall put some of the blood on the horns of the altar which is before Yahweh, that is in the Tent of Meeting; and the rest of the blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar of burnt offering, which is at the door of the Tent of Meeting.

paite: Athau tengteng ala vek dia, maitam ah ahal ding.
english: All its fat he shall take from it, and burn it on the altar.

paite: Huchibang in bawng pen ahih dia; khelh thoihna bawng ahih bang geih in hiai leng ahih ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in kilemna abawl ding a, ngaihdam ahi ding uhi.
english: Thus shall he do with the bull; as he did with the bull of the sin offering, so shall he do with this; and the priest shall make atonement for them, and they shall be forgiven.

paite: Huai bawng giahphual pua ah apaipih dia, bawng masa ahal bang in ahal ding hi. Hiai mipi a dia khelh thoihna ahi.
english: He shall carry forth the bull outside the camp, and burn it as he burned the first bull. It is the sin offering for the assembly.

paite: "Vaihawmtu in thil ahihkhelh a, TOUPA a Pathian in hih louh ding a thu apiakte abang pen hiam ahihkhak a, siam louh atan a,
english: “‘When a ruler sins, and unwittingly does any one of all the things which Yahweh his God has commanded not to be done, and is guilty;

paite: athil gilou hih atheihleh athillat ding in kelpa gensiatbei ahon kai ding ahi.
english: if his sin, in which he has sinned, is made known to him, he shall bring as his offering a goat, a male without blemish.

paite: Kel lutung ah akhut akoih dia, TOUPA ma ah halmang thillat agoh zelna uah agou ding hi”. Hiai khelh thoihna ahi.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the goat, and kill it in the place where they kill the burnt offering before Yahweh. It is a sin offering.

paite: Siampu in khelh thoihna sisan akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, maitam kiite ah halmang thillat atat dia, halmang thillat maitam bul ah asisan asungkhe ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering. He shall pour out the rest of its blood at the base of the altar of burnt offering.

paite: Athau tengteng, lemna thillat kithoihna thau ahal bang in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in akhelhna tungthu ah siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: All its fat he shall burn on the altar, like the fat of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin, and he will be forgiven.

paite: "Vantang lak a mi, akuamah mah in TOUPA'N hih louh ding a thu apiakte abangmah hihkhial in, siam louh na tangleh,
english: “‘If anyone of the common people sins unwittingly, in doing any of the things which Yahweh has commanded not to be done, and is guilty;

paite: athil gilou hih atheihleh athillat ding in kelnu gensiatbei, athilhihkhelhsa khelh thoihna ding in ahon kai ding hi”.
english: if his sin, which he has sinned, is made known to him, then he shall bring for his offering a goat, a female without blemish, for his sin which he has sinned.

paite: "Khelh thoihna lutung ah akhut akoih dia, halmang thillatna mun ah khelh thoihna agou ding hi”.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

paite: Siampu in asisan, akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, halmang thillat maitam kiite ah atat dia, asisan tengteng maitam bul ah asungkhe ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of its blood with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

paite: Athau tengteng lemna thillat kithoihna thau alak bang in ala vek ding hi. Siampu in TOUPA a dia gimlim ding in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat is taken away from off of the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn it on the altar for a pleasant aroma to Yahweh; and the priest shall make atonement for him, and he will be forgiven.

paite: "Khelh thoihna dia athillat ding belamnou ahon tawileh, anu, gensiatbei ahon tawi ding ahi”.
english: “‘If he brings a lamb as his offering for a sin offering, he shall bring a female without blemish.

paite: Khelh thoihna lutung ah akhut akoih dia, halmang thillat agohna uah khelhna thoihna ding in agou ding hi.
english: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.

paite: Siampu in khelh thoihna sisan akhutzung in tam lou ala dia, halmang thillat maitam kiite ah atat dia, sisan tengteng maitam bul ah asungkhe ding hi.
english: The priest shall take some of the blood of the sin offering with his finger, and put it on the horns of the altar of burnt offering; and all the rest of its blood he shall pour out at the base of the altar.

paite: Athau tengteng, belamnou thau, lemna thillat kithoihna alak bang in ala vek ding a, siampu in TOUPA a dia mei a thillat bang in maitam ah ahal ding ahi. Huchi in siampu in athilhihkhelhsa tungthu ah kilemna abawlsak dia, ngaihdam ahi ding hi.
english: All its fat he shall take away, like the fat of the lamb is taken away from the sacrifice of peace offerings; and the priest shall burn them on the altar, on the offerings of Yahweh made by fire; and the priest shall make atonement for him concerning his sin that he has sinned, and he will be forgiven.
